title: Ali's Village
text:
My friend Ali has a small house in a quiet village. The house is white and it has a red door. There is a big garden behind the house. Ali has two cats and a dog in the garden.

The village is very beautiful. There are many trees and a small river. In the morning, Ali walks by the river with his dog. He says it is the best place in the world.

questions.text: What color is the door of Ali's house?
What does Ali walk by in the morning?
What kind of place is Ali's village probably?
How does Ali probably feel about his village?

vocabulary.definition: a piece of land next to a house where plants or animals are kept
a large natural stream of water that flows to the sea or a lake

paragraph_translations: Arkadaşım Ali'nin sessiz bir köyde küçük bir evi var. Evin beyaz ve kırmızı bir kapısı var. Evin arkasında büyük bir bahçe var. Ali'nin bahçede iki kedisi ve bir köpeği var.
Köy çok güzel. Birçok ağaç ve küçük bir nehir var. Sabahları Ali köpeğiyle nehir kenarında yürür. Onun bu dünyadaki en iyi yer olduğunu söyler.
